from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


class SanitizeError(RuntimeError):
    pass


GIT_PREFIX = [
    "git",
    "-c",
    "core.autocrlf=false",
    "-c",
    "core.safecrlf=false",
]


def _run(
    cmd: list[str],
    *,
    cwd: Path,
    check: bool = True,
) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        cmd,
        cwd=str(cwd),
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
    )
    if check and proc.returncode != 0:
        raise SanitizeError(
            f"{' '.join(cmd)} fehlgeschlagen: "
            f"{(proc.stderr or proc.stdout).strip()}"
        )
    return proc


def _git(
    repo: Path,
    *args: str,
    check: bool = True,
) -> str:
    return _run(
        [*GIT_PREFIX, *args],
        cwd=repo,
        check=check,
    ).stdout.strip()


def _base_entry(
    repo: Path,
    base_ref: str,
    rel_path: str,
) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
    raw = _git(
        repo,
        "ls-tree",
        base_ref,
        "--",
        rel_path,
        check=False,
    )
    if not raw:
        return None

    first = raw.splitlines()[0]
    meta, _, _ = first.partition("\t")
    parts = meta.split()
    if len(parts) < 3 or parts[1] != "blob":
        return None
    return parts[0], parts[2]


def _restore_exact_base_blob(
    repo: Path,
    base_ref: str,
    rel_path: str,
) -> None:
    entry = _base_entry(
        repo,
        base_ref,
        rel_path,
    )

    if entry is None:
        _git(
            repo,
            "update-index",
            "--force-remove",
            "--",
            rel_path,
            check=False,
        )
        target = (repo / rel_path).resolve()
        try:
            target.relative_to(repo.resolve())
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise SanitizeError(
                "Pfad außerhalb des Repository."
            ) from exc
        if target.is_dir():
            shutil.rmtree(target)
        elif target.exists():
            target.unlink()
        return

    mode, blob = entry
    _git(
        repo,
        "update-index",
        "--add",
        "--cacheinfo",
        f"{mode},{blob},{rel_path}",
    )

    # Schreibe exakt den Blob aus dem Index in den Worktree.
    # core.autocrlf=false verhindert, dass CRLF/LF dabei erneut verändert wird.
    _git(
        repo,
        "checkout-index",
        "-f",
        "--",
        rel_path,
    )


def sanitize(
    repo: Path,
    base_ref: str,
    handoff: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    strict = bool(
        handoff.get("strict_target_paths")
    )
    target_paths = {
        str(item)
        for item in handoff.get("target_paths", [])
    }

    changed = [
        line.strip()
        for line in _git(
            repo,
            "diff",
            "--name-only",
            f"{base_ref}...HEAD",
        ).splitlines()
        if line.strip()
    ]

    unexpected = sorted(
        path
        for path in changed
        if target_paths and path not in target_paths
    )

    if not strict or not unexpected:
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "strict_target_paths": strict,
            "changed": False,
            "unexpected_paths": unexpected,
            "restored_paths": [],
        }

    branch = _git(
        repo,
        "branch",
        "--show-current",
    )
    if not branch.startswith("ai/job-"):
        raise SanitizeError(
            "Sanitizer darf nur auf isolierten "
            "ai/job-* Branches committen."
        )

    restored: list[str] = []
    for rel_path in unexpected:
        _restore_exact_base_blob(
            repo,
            base_ref,
            rel_path,
        )
        restored.append(rel_path)

    staged = _git(
        repo,
        "diff",
        "--cached",
        "--name-only",
    )

    if not staged:
        # Wenn HEAD bereits exakt dem Basisblob entspricht, bleibt nichts zu committen.
        _git(
            repo,
            "reset",
            "--hard",
            "HEAD",
        )
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "strict_target_paths": strict,
            "changed": False,
            "unexpected_paths": unexpected,
            "restored_paths": restored,
        }

    _run(
        [
            *GIT_PREFIX,
            "-c",
            "user.name=Hermclaw Runtime",
            "-c",
            "user.email=runtime@hermclaw.local",
            "commit",
            "-m",
            (
                "Runtime: restore files outside "
                "strict handoff targets"
            ),
        ],
        cwd=repo,
    )

    _git(
        repo,
        "push",
        "origin",
        f"HEAD:{branch}",
    )

    # Worktree exakt zum gerade erzeugten Commit synchronisieren.
    _git(
        repo,
        "reset",
        "--hard",
        "HEAD",
    )

    remaining = [
        line.strip()
        for line in _git(
            repo,
            "diff",
            "--name-only",
            f"{base_ref}...HEAD",
        ).splitlines()
        if line.strip()
        and line.strip() not in target_paths
    ]
    if remaining:
        raise SanitizeError(
            "Strict-Target-Sanitizer konnte fachfremde "
            "Änderungen nicht vollständig entfernen: "
            + ", ".join(remaining)
        )

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "strict_target_paths": strict,
        "changed": True,
        "unexpected_paths": unexpected,
        "restored_paths": restored,
        "branch": branch,
        "head": _git(
            repo,
            "rev-parse",
            "HEAD",
        ),
    }


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            "Stellt bei strikt eingegrenzten Handoffs "
            "fachfremde Änderungen deterministisch wieder her."
        )
    )
    parser.add_argument("--repo", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--base-ref", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--handoff", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    repo = Path(args.repo).resolve()
    handoff = json.loads(
        Path(args.handoff).read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )
    result = sanitize(
        repo,
        args.base_ref,
        handoff,
    )

    Path(args.output).write_text(
        json.dumps(
            result,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
        + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    if result["changed"]:
        print(
            "[SANITIZE] Fachfremde Änderungen "
            "wiederhergestellt: "
            + ", ".join(
                result["restored_paths"]
            )
        )
    else:
        print(
            "[SANITIZE] Keine Wiederherstellung nötig."
        )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from model_runtime.sanitize_result_branch import (
    sanitize,
)


def git(cwd: Path, *args: str) -> str:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [
            "git",
            "-c",
            "core.autocrlf=false",
            *args,
        ],
        cwd=str(cwd),
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        check=True,
    )
    return proc.stdout.strip()


class SanitizeResultBranchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_restores_unexpected_file_on_strict_job_branch(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            base = Path(tmp)
            remote = base / "remote.git"
            repo = base / "repo"

            git(
                base,
                "init",
                "--bare",
                str(remote),
            )
            git(
                base,
                "clone",
                str(remote),
                str(repo),
            )
            git(
                repo,
                "config",
                "user.name",
                "Test",
            )
            git(
                repo,
                "config",
                "user.email",
                "test@example.invalid",
            )

            (repo / "wanted.txt").write_text(
                "base\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (repo / "noise.bat").write_bytes(
                b"base\r\n"
            )
            git(repo, "add", "-A")
            git(repo, "commit", "-m", "base")
            base_sha = git(
                repo,
                "rev-parse",
                "HEAD",
            )
            git(
                repo,
                "push",
                "-u",
                "origin",
                "HEAD:main",
            )

            branch = "ai/job-test-sanitize"
            git(
                repo,
                "checkout",
                "-b",
                branch,
            )
            (repo / "wanted.txt").write_text(
                "wanted change\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (repo / "noise.bat").write_bytes(
                b"base\n"
            )
            git(repo, "add", "-A")
            git(repo, "commit", "-m", "agent")
            git(
                repo,
                "push",
                "-u",
                "origin",
                branch,
            )

            result = sanitize(
                repo,
                base_sha,
                {
                    "strict_target_paths": True,
                    "target_paths": [
                        "wanted.txt"
                    ],
                },
            )

            self.assertTrue(
                result["changed"]
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                (repo / "noise.bat").read_bytes(),
                b"base\r\n",
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                (repo / "wanted.txt").read_text(
                    encoding="utf-8"
                ),
                "wanted change\n",
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                git(
                    repo,
                    "diff",
                    "--name-only",
                    f"{base_sha}...HEAD",
                ).splitlines(),
                ["wanted.txt"],
            )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from model_runtime.salvage_agent_workspace import (
    salvage,
)


def git(cwd: Path, *args: str) -> str:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [
            "git",
            "-c",
            "core.autocrlf=false",
            *args,
        ],
        cwd=str(cwd),
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        check=True,
    )
    return proc.stdout.strip()


class SalvageAgentWorkspaceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_strict_salvage_ignores_dirty_unexpected_file(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            base = Path(tmp)
            remote = base / "remote.git"
            workspaces = base / "workspaces"
            workspaces.mkdir()
            repo = workspaces / "job-workspace"

            git(
                base,
                "init",
                "--bare",
                str(remote),
            )
            git(
                base,
                "clone",
                str(remote),
                str(repo),
            )
            git(
                repo,
                "config",
                "user.name",
                "Test",
            )
            git(
                repo,
                "config",
                "user.email",
                "test@example.invalid",
            )

            (repo / "wanted.txt").write_text(
                "base\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (repo / "noise.bat").write_bytes(
                b"base\r\n"
            )
            git(repo, "add", "-A")
            git(repo, "commit", "-m", "base")
            git(
                repo,
                "push",
                "-u",
                "origin",
                "HEAD:main",
            )

            job_id = (
                "routing-v02-main-test-i0-123"
            )
            branch = (
                f"ai/job-{job_id}-main-coder"
            )
            git(
                repo,
                "checkout",
                "-b",
                branch,
            )

            (repo / "wanted.txt").write_text(
                "wanted change\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (repo / "noise.bat").write_bytes(
                b"base\n"
            )

            result = salvage(
                job_id,
                workspace_root=workspaces,
                expected_origin=str(remote),
                handoff={
                    "strict_target_paths": True,
                    "target_paths": [
                        "wanted.txt"
                    ],
                },
            )

            self.assertTrue(
                result["salvaged"]
            )
            self.assertIn(
                "noise.bat",
                result[
                    "restored_unexpected"
                ],
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                result["branch"],
                branch,
            )

            diff = git(
                repo,
                "diff",
                "--name-only",
                "main...HEAD",
            ).splitlines()
            self.assertEqual(
                diff,
                ["wanted.txt"],
            )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
